items: Studio exposes the eight current workspaces
scrolling over an unselected component never mutates its geometry
scrolling does not implicitly select a component
Add panel inserts a structured section
dragging an Add primitive onto the canvas creates a real node
direct text editing updates the canvas
uploaded user media inserts onto the canvas
selection opens contextual top toolbar
contextual toolbar changes typography and effects
pointer drag moves a structured element
smart alignment guide appears during an intentional drag
smart alignment guide clears after release and commits geometry
resize handle changes text geometry
contextual opacity control changes the selected object
keyboard duplicate creates an independent document node
duplicate receives a new stable ID
duplicated canvas objects can overlap
document-aware copy and paste creates a new node
Delete removes the selected document node
Undo restores the deleted node
Redo reapplies the deletion
pointer resize changes image geometry
image crop mode supports drag, zoom and Done
responsive editor switches to mobile canvas
keyboard undo and redo execute against document history
layer order changes through the reference context menu
autosave persists geometry, typography, opacity, link, image crop/fitting, and effects
full Studio reload restores persisted changes
Studio journey has zero uncaught browser errors
